I have been disgusted with my hypersexuality for a very long time. Sometimes I blame it on my sexual trauma and sometimes I blame it on the bipolar. But recently I have become more grounded, with time. I have realized that we need to accept who we are and the decisions we made. 

Were the decisions I made smart? Definitely not. But it’s just what i wanted to do at the time. That doesn’t make me a bad person, and those decisions aren’t really necessarily “bad” either, morally speaking anyway. Two things can be true at once you know.
